$comment: p15-oracle-061: the browser family's 17 mutations (gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file; run it after an edit). The VM daemon has no cmux-browser provider, so a daemon-rendered browser (fx-browser) is engine_unavailable there: the success cases of the nine engine ops require chromium and wait for the browser to go live; their error cases drive the app-drawn browser of fx-app-browser, which every daemon has, and get the refusal the router gives it (operation.failed, details.extra.code browser_rendered_by_app, resource_router/content.rs browser_effect). The record ops (close, devices, profiles, emulation) run on any daemon against fx-app-browser.
